title: RunningView
description: What the running screen shows. Exactly these fields.

elapsed_ms.description: Time since the first GPS fix, ms. 0 before the first fix.

distance_m.description: Distance run, metres: the sum of the distances between successive fixes. 0 before any.

pace_s_per_km.description: Current pace, seconds per kilometre, over roughly the last 30 s. null until it can be worked out.

splits_ms.description: How long each of the last 5 completed kilometres took, ms, oldest first. Empty before the first kilometre is complete.

lap_ms.description: Time in the current lap, ms: since the first fix, or since the last Lap press.

last_lap_ms.description: How long the most recently finished lap took, ms. null before the first Lap press.
